newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico changes date for opening railroad bids.
newsitem.headline: Mexico changes date for opening railroad bids.

text.p: Mexico's Communications and Transport Ministry said on Thursday it had changed the date for opening bids on the privatisation of the Northeast rail system to December 5 from December 9.
The Northeast system includes the routes Mexico City-Nuevo Laredo, Monterrey-Matamoros, Aguascalientes-Tampico, Mexico City-Veracruz and Mexico City-Lazaro Cardenas.
Companies interested in making bids must do so by November 29.
The Northeast system will be the first of five segments of state-owned rail lines to be privatised in Mexico.

The first was going to be the Chihuahua-Pacific line running through the famed Copper Canyon, a major tourist attraction. However, that was suspended when the only economic proposal submitted did not meet the government's minimum standards.
